name: Sage

schedule.notes: Pick lightly the first year. Year 2+: cut whole branches before flowering.

harvest.cues: Leaves silver-green, soft-fuzzy, before flowering. Snip 6 in stems.
harvest.storageNotes: Dries beautifully — flavor mellows from intense to sweet-piney. Hang bundles in shade.

varieties.name: Purple Sage
varieties.notes: Deep purple new growth. Slightly milder.

varieties.name: Tricolor
varieties.notes: Pink, white, and green variegated. Less cold-hardy.

notes: Replace every 3 to 4 years — old plants get woody and lose flavor. Cut hard in early spring to encourage new growth from the base.
